method: Serial circle steps, radius 10, unit mass, 22-unit grid, 55-unit/s pursuit, 30 warmups. Neon tracks contacts. Box2D uses four substeps and buffered contact events. Timed steps exclude body creation and common velocity input. This excludes rendering, ECS, engine contact collection and continuous sensors. Different collision response; no gameplay parity claim. Aborting thread stubs permit compiling Neon's unchanged source without its optional thread dependency; pool is NULL.
